tools.description: get_document: Retrieving single Frappe documents with full field and child table data. Detailed guidance: fac://skills/get-document-usage

fields.description: Only these fields (a child table's fieldname returns its rows). Omit for all.

name.description: The document name/ID (e.g., 'CUST-00001', 'SINV-00001'). This is the unique identifier for the document.

tools.name: get_document

tools.description: list_documents: Searching and listing Frappe documents with filters, field selection, ordering, and response format. Detailed guidance: fac://skills/list-documents-usage

aggregate.description: Aggregates per group, e.g. [{'function': 'sum', 'field': 'grand_total'}]. With group_by and no aggregate you get the record count per group; without group_by you get one total row.

field.description: Fieldname to aggregate. sum and avg need a Currency, Float, Int or Percent field.

doctype.description: The Frappe DocType to search (e.g., 'Customer', 'Sales Invoice', 'Item', 'User'). Must match exact DocType name.

fields.description: Specific fields to retrieve. Examples: ['name', 'customer_name', 'email'], ['name', 'item_name', 'item_code']. Leave empty to get standard fields.

filters.description: Search filters as key-value pairs. Examples: {'status': 'Active'}, {'customer_type': 'Company'}, {'creation': ['>', '2024-01-01']}. Use empty {} to get all records. For submittable DocTypes, docstatus=1 (submitted) is applied automatically unless you set docstatus yourself — pass {'docstatus': 2} for cancelled, {'docstatus': [0, 1]} for drafts and submitted. To filter by a value in a child table, name it 'Child DocType.field', e.g. {'Has Role.role': 'Sales User'} on User.

group_by.description: Fieldname to group by, for totals per group (e.g. 'customer', 'territory', a custom field). The database computes the totals, over only records the user may read — use this instead of adding up listed rows yourself. Ignores fields and offset. A Date field groups by exact day (each distinct date is its own group), not by month or year.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return. Default is 20, maximum is 1000.

offset.description: Number of matching records to skip. When a response has has_more=true, pass its next_offset here to read the next page.

order_by.description: Order results by field, e.g. 'creation desc', 'name asc'. Omit to use the DocType's own default ordering (usually modified desc). With group_by, order_by must instead be one aggregate alias (function_field, e.g. 'sum_grand_total') plus asc or desc, to rank groups by total; groups otherwise sort by the group value.

tools.name: list_documents
